$comment: Kit toolchain manifest - DATA only (versions, floors, policy); version probing and the doctor report live in cli/src/engine-native/toolchain.ts, and the one managed install lives in cli/src/engine-native/bun.ts bunBootstrap. kind: check (doctor visibility only) | managed (kit installs it when missing) | pin (no binary probe - a version pin for a package the kit installs through another tool, such as npx or `omp install`; `via` names that tool in the doctor table, default npx). policy (managed only): present (install when missing, never upgrade). `verified` = last kit-tested version; `pinnable` marks a tool whose `verified` release the bootstrap can install by exact tag. Supply-chain stance: every kit-driven package install from npm, npx, GitHub releases, or `omp install` is pinned to `verified` - never floating @latest (npm-worm/Shai-Hulud surface). The existing omp marketplace plugins follow their marketplace and have no pin. Any new install surface, a new marketplace or plugin source included, needs a pin first. Update `verified` after testing a new release. upstream (optional) names where `docks-kit toolchain outdated` reads the newest release: npm package or GitHub repo releases with a tag prefix; results cache 24 h in ~/.docks-kit/kit.db; the report never installs or edits pins.

jq.note: optional operator CLI; EngineNative JSON handling does not invoke it

curl.note: installer transport for the Bun bootstrap on every host (install.sh on POSIX, install.ps1 on Windows); probed only when Bun is missing

git.note: omp plugin marketplaces (omp clones them) + kit checkout updates

node.note: runs npx for the skills CLI

npm.note: npm-global installer; `docks-kit update` uses it for an npm-installed kit

omp.note: Oh My Pi harness (https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi); upstream-owned. It updates through `omp update` or through the external manager that owns the install (for example Tern), and sync never installs or upgrades it. The floor is the oldest release the kit tested: 19.0.0 lists every model selector of the kit roles exactly, accepts every key of SoT/.omp/config.yml, and runs the bash approval order that cli/test/lib/ompBashPatterns.ts ports. `sync omp` needs the CLI only for the marketplace and plugin passes; the file deploys proceed without it

bun.note: runtime for the docks-kit CLI; bootstrap installs the verified release (installer takes bun-vX.Y.Z); self-updates via `bun upgrade` when wanted. By owner decision (2026-09-25), the floor equals the verified pin and the CI Bun, and the checkout launchers refuse an older Bun. All three moved to 1.4.4 on 2026-10-22 for `bun check`

skills-cli.note: the `skills` npm package the kit runs via `npx skills@<verified>` when SoT/.agents/skills.txt names a slug (it is empty by default) — pinned, never @latest

pi-intercom.note: the cross-session messaging plugin ompSync installs with `omp install pi-intercom@<verified>` - pinned, never floating. Its broker runs under Bun because omp's flat plugin store cannot resolve the default `npx --no-install tsx` launcher
